entity.name: Jakob Heuser
entity.description: Jakob Heuser (theCodeDrift) builds and maintains pvtch, a set of free streaming tools for Twitch creators.

projects.name: pvtch
projects.description: Free, self-hostable streaming tools for Twitch creators: OBS widgets such as progress bars and to-do lists, AI chat translation, and a chat bot. It runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers and fits within Cloudflare's free tier, so any streamer can deploy their own copy.

channels.description: One-time or recurring support through Ko-fi.

plans.name: Supporter
plans.description: Pay what you like, once or every month, to keep pvtch free and hosted.
